title: CliResult
description: D-07 daemon-local CLI result contract. The response half of the CLI↔daemon channel. stateFreshness is REQUIRED on every result (SC#3 surfaces here) and every result carries assumptions[] plumbing from day one (UX-06). Source: CONTEXT.md D-07/D-10 + RESEARCH.md Pattern 3 + 'assumptions[] shape'.
$comment: Phase 2 freezes the result contract. TRUST-SPINE: (1) stateFreshness REQUIRED — stale state cannot be silently shipped as live (SC#3, T-2-01-I). (2) The allOf if/then discriminator mirrors handshake.schema.json lines 44-66: when ok:false the result MUST carry error+availableFrom and MUST NOT carry payload — a stub cannot accidentally ship a fake success payload (T-2-01-S). This is the not_implemented arm for the 3 stub commands (D-05). (3) assumptions[] items carry {claim,confidence,source} (UX-06). availableFrom enum [M2,M3,M4] matches the milestone plan (M2=MIDI patching, M3=arrangement, M4=automation).

type.description: Discriminator. Always 'result' on the response half.

ok.description: Success flag. REQUIRED. Drives the allOf conditional shape below.

stateFreshness.description: SC#3 staleness marker. REQUIRED on every result so staleness surfaces to every CLI consumer (RESEARCH.md lines 598-601). 'live' = bridge recently observed; 'stale' = bridge silent past watchdog threshold; 'disconnected' = bridge gone.

payload.description: Op-specific result payload. Present (and allowed) only when ok:true. The allOf block FORBIDS payload when ok:false.

availableFrom.description: Milestone when this op ships for real. REQUIRED when ok:false (the stub arm). M2=MIDI patching, M3=arrangement, M4=automation.

assumptions.description: UX-06: every result states the assumptions behind its payload. Attached from day one. Each item carries {claim, confidence, source}. Optional at the schema level (a minimal result like a stub's not_implemented may carry none); populated by every result that ships a derived/observed payload.

claim.description: Human-readable assumption, e.g. 'selected clip has 32 notes' or 'intent says preserve bass motif'.

confidence.description: Confidence ∈ [0,1]. 1.0 = directly observed; 0.5 = inferred; <0.5 should not appear (dropped by the registry).
